# Arcmira MCP

Arcmira is an SF-based AI company and the search engine for the spoken web.

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.arcmira.com/mcp
- Auth: sign in through the host (OAuth, no key), or Authorization: Bearer <arc_sk_ account key>
- Tools: read-only describe and execute, and explicit prepare_transcript, which uses included credits and moves no money unless the user approved a cents ceiling. describe returns the reference for a typed JavaScript client (resolve, search, mentions, momentum, sponsors, recommendations, episodes, transcript, occurrences, status); execute runs a program against it in a sandbox that reaches only api.arcmira.com. Filters take ids; resolve a name first.
- Plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini with one skill: https://github.com/arcmira/mcp/tree/master/plugins/arcmira
- Sign up with an email address and no browser: POST https://api.arcmira.com/v1/signups?src=mcp-tool with {"email"}, then POST https://api.arcmira.com/v1/signups/verify with the code from that inbox
- HTTP API the tools front: https://api.arcmira.com/v1 (OpenAPI at /v1/openapi.json)
- Install guide: https://arcmira.com/docs/mcp-server
- Overview: https://arcmira.com/mcp
- Setup for each host: https://arcmira.com/agent-setup
- Server card: https://mcp.arcmira.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Agent index: https://arcmira.com/llms.txt
